non-blocking: the guard's exact comparison assumes extended precision before the profile is built; ForwardProfile.from_lattice stores external_current through jnp.asarray (nova/equilibrium/forward.py:694), and with x64 left off (the default after importing nova.imas.diiid_current, measured) a shipped value truncates to float32 (e.g. -177235.03600582798 becomes -177235.03125), so an unpatched profile built before configure_dtypes is refused with a disagreement that is a precision artifact.
